scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: RD Gaikwad
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b Yash Thakur

batting.name: S Dube
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b MP Stoinis

batting.name: Sameer Rizvi
batting.dismissal: st KL Rahul b KH Pandya

batting.name: MM Ali
batting.dismissal: c A Badoni b Ravi Bishnoi

batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b Mustafizur Rahman

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b M Pathirana

balls.text: yorker-length outside off again, Dhoni stays deep inside the crease and opens the bat face late to slice this behind point. What a finish by MS Dhoni!
whips this down to deep midwicket, calls for two and gets it. What a cameo yet again
off the edge, spins away between point and short third. Thakur did well to angle across a wide yorker but Dhoni's bat speed meant the ball still flew away
muscled! Stood deep inside the crease, got underneath the length as Yash Thakur missed his yorker and saw this slotball smashed wide of long-on.
toe-ends this slog to mid-off, brings Dhoni back on strike
this full toss has been hit into the gap at sweeper cover, they hare back for the second
has a big heave but misses
dug in short but this sails way over Dhoni's head as he tries to hook him out of the park, wide called
short ball into the pitch, Jadeja is cramped for room as he can only just manage to hit it uppishly over cover
wide signalled! It's also a short ball that Jadeja fails to connect. LSG have reviewed Anil Chaudhary's call. Given fair delivery as the ball was head-height as it passed Jadeja.  Not a wide
eased down to third man
walks across the stumps and uses the bowler's pace to help him over the bowler's head. The top-edge carries all the way.

drilled over cover, and he picks the gap to perfection. Bishnoi came around the ropes, half-hoping he gets to the ball. He ended up exceeding his own expectations, yet couldn't catch because that was hit like a bullet

beaten as he attempts to cut this slower length ball angling away. Dhoni challenges the wide call and wins it. The ball was just outside the wide line, reckons the third umpire. Quite bizarre to be honest.
slants it too full and too far wide outside off, left alone
gets a juicy full toss, pushed to long-off to get off the mark

picks out deep midwicket this time. Didn't time it as well as he would've liked, Moeen's followthrough and his reaction as he hit it was a dead giveaway, but hey, he walks off to a rousing reception. Ekana stands.......because MS Dhoni's walking out

flat-batted to clear long-off! Absolutely clobbered that length ball angled across. Raises the half-century of the partnership. Moeen has messed with Bishnoi. Because he's been clobbered by the tossed up deliveries, he goes flat, Moeen did well to hang back and wallop that
this one is even bigger and better! Tossed up on middle and leg, Moeen is down on one knee very quickly as he slog-sweeps this over the short boundary at deep midwicket.
swung over the ropes at deep square! Tossed up this time by Bishnoi, this was right into Moeen's hitting arc.
fired full on the pads, it's a wrong'un, Moeen struck on the pad as he heaves across the line and misses
gloves the pull to fine leg
pulled all along the ground to long leg
beaten by a short ball into the pitch

makes room to go over the top and Mohsin ends up bowling full into his hitting arc, Jadeja swings through the line and manages to just about clear Hooda who makes a mess of that at long-on. He ended up tipping it over the ropes.  Brings up a half-century and the sword celebration
fetches the pull from outside off, down to deep square
slower ball into the pitch on a length, Jadeja looks to lap him but ends up dabbing it to short third instead
drills this straight to cover
scythed into the gap at point, good work by Bishnoi running around the ropes from square third to cut that off
into the blockhole, squeezed out to cover
short and wide, trying to bowl it outside Jadeja's hitting arc, but this has been cleverly deflected wide of short third
sweeps this full toss straight to square leg
pushed to long-off
dabbed to point for a single
mistimes this googly as he attempts to loft it down the ground, long-off comes around to cut that off
punched to deep point
worked to midwicket again
worked into the midwicket region, the boundary rider had too much work to do, couldn't have prevented the second
looks to tuck it into the leg side, gets a leading edge that rolls wide of point
top-edges a pull, rolls down to deep backward square leg
off-cutter on a length around off, dabbed behind point
driven straight to cover
mistimes a pull to long-on
length outside off, steered to deep point
length on off, pushed to cover
worked around the corner to long leg
driven firmly to long-off
dabs it to short third, quick single taken
works it straight to midwicket

poor shot under the circumstances. Runs down the pitch to heave across the line, Krunal cleverly dragged his length back and got this to turn and Rahul effects the simplest of stumpings. Completely lost his shape.
works this flatter one into the leg side for a single
whipped across the line to deep square
tucked away to deep midwicket
hits hard length on middle, Rizvi can only push it to as far as short midwicket
beaten on the inside edge as this not just cut back in but kept low too
cutter into the pitch on a length, Rizvi rises with the bounce as he defends

excellent catch! Dube looks to fetch this pull from way outside off but ends up slicing it high in the air as Rahul calls for it and then hares forward to take it neatly. Didn't look like dropping it at any point.
whips it down to deep midwicket
beats him with an excellent bumper. Dube is beaten for pace as he tries to hook him.
stifled lbw appeal as Jadeja is struck on the pad with a full ball angling in. No real hope there, just misplaced optimism. They scamper a leg bye
pulled to deep backward square leg
tucks it off his hip to square leg
slips it down leg, Jadeja attempts to flick it fine but it rolls off the pad past short fine
beats him with a fizzing googly. Dube was looking to lean into a drive but was in no position to play that
nudged into the leg side for a quick single
picks the bones out of this sweep in front of square! Hit flat and really hard, midwicket hardly moved to try and stop that
steered to point
whips it across the line to wide long-on, Nicky P just a tad late to take off
slaps this short ball to cover, good stop by Stoinis throwing himself to his right
tucked to deep square, Bishnoi does superbly well to get to the ball quickly and release it flat and hard
paddled around the corner to beat short fine! Cleverly done from Jadeja. Moved around to try and throw the bowler off, succeeded
mistimes the pull to deep square, off the mark
flatter one angled across, defended back down the pitch
flatter one on middle and leg, pushes it to midwicket
got him! Rahane plays all across the line, trying to swing this length ball pushed through and hears the leg-stump rattled.
thinks he has beat him with a wrong'un but the ball races past short third to the boundary. Jadeja played for the turn in but was foxed. Gets lucky.
attempts to back away and loft, flies over the bowler off the inside half
heaves across the line and although he didn't hit it off the middle, gets the desired result as the gap between fine leg and deep midwicket is split.
shortish on middle and leg, swivels to help it around but hits straight to short fine
drifts one across on a length, cut away to deep point
chipped uppishly over midwicket
whipped to the man coming in from deep midwicket
punched to deep midwicket, Henry had to run in considerably from the wide long-on fence, they take two easy
gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad as he looks to whip it square, they jog through for a single
laps it to short fine, they get through for a single
pushed through quicker on middle and leg, tucked to deep square
worked straight to midwicket
pushed to mid-off, Jadeja was on the move and sprints across for the single in a jiffy
neatly tucked off the pads to deep square, Henry slowed it down
angling into the pads, worked to midwicket
works it to mid-on for a quick single
tucks it to square leg
just out of mid-off's reach! Jadeja backs away and smacks this slot-ball over the infield
scorching drive on the up! Sumptuous from Rahane as he plants forward and hits through the line without a trace of worry.
squares him up with a peach but the edge drawn runs away fine, between keeper and short third. And so, even though Thakur genuinely had Rahane nicking, he's caught tearing his hair out.
steered to third man
beats him with a beauty! Hangs his bat out to waft at a length ball around fifth stump
comes back wonderfully! Thakur gets this length ball to move away just a touch, Gaikwad drives away from the body and ends up nicking behind, good catch by Rahul diving to his right.
guides it away to the right of short third. Precise placement
heaves across the line and gets away with it! The thick edge flies between keeper and short third.
slower delivery into the pitch, Rahane has no pace to work with but still dabs it to short third, no chance of a run
mistimes a drive to mid-off, but they manage to get through for a single
driven straight to deep point
excellent diving stop by Stoinis at extra cover. Threw himself to his left to cut that off
hint of width outside off, punched down to deep backward point. Ayush Badoni stops the ball as he comes around from square third man
imperious! Picks the length early and belts this short of length delivery in front of square to clear the midwicket boundary.
uses the bowler's pace to once again run it down to third man
keeps a tad low as Gaikwad somehow manages to run it down to third man, good running to come back for the second
gorgeous cover drive but there's sweeper cover for protection as de Kock comes around to cut that off
gets well forward as he drives straight to cover
square driven to third man, good stop in the deep by Quinton de Kock with the slide
mistimes an attempted cover drive back towards the bowler
off the edge, rolls to short third as they take a single.
punched straight to point
dabs it gently into the off side as they steal a single under the bowler's nose
pushed to mid-off as they scamper a quick single

straight through him! That is an absolute corker first up. Slants one in full on the stumps from wide of the crease and Rachin nibbles down the wrong line as he tries to off-drive. The ball beats the inside edge to crash into the stumps.
steered straight to gully, good comeback after being whacked for an early boundary
full length and just around off, defended back
full on the stumps, works it straight to mid-on. Looks like Rahane was trying to hit that a lot straighter
squirted off a thickish inside edge to mid-on.
short, width and crashed through point. Stood tall and flayed that away off the backfoot.
floated full on off-stump, driven firmly to mid-off
All over! Back of a length angling away, Pooran slaps it over the leaping cover fielder. A comprehensive win for LSG
Beamer on the stumps, and he misses the ramp. No ball called. CSK have reviewed. Why? Sheer waste of time
Full toss on off, clipped to deep midwicket
Low full toss outside off, sliced to deep point for two more
Length ball just outside off, he goes for the heave across the line and gets an inside edge to the wicketkeeper
Another full and wide one, Stoin does not make contact again
Full and wide again, Stoin does not connect, wide called

Bowls it full and wide outside off from around the stumps, Stoinis manages to connect it to smack it through cover. Rizvi rushes to his right from deep point and puts in the dive but fails to prevent four
On leg, knocked down to long-on
Full on leg, flicked to midwicket

Very full on the pad, he misses the flick. Pathirana puts a belated appeal for lbw. Not given. Gaikwad wants to take the review. Looked to have pitched outside leg and did not seem like it was headed on to the stumps.Yep, that is the case, pitched outside leg
Very full outside off, reaches out and gets it to deep backward point
Strays on the pads, misses the tickle. Gets a couple of leg-byes
Very full on off, keeps it out to the on side

Jadeja flier ends Rahul's stay! Leaps to his left from backward point and dives to pluck it out. Wrings his left hand after the effort. Superb effort to end a top knock. He stands deep and cuts a length ball that is well outside off. But he couldn't get it past a flying Jaddu. Looks like the TV ump wants to check the fairness of the catch and it is all good. It was an umpire's review. Delays proceedings a touch
Wider outside off, cut to deep third

You or me? Noone! Rizvi runs from deep third, Ravindra runs from deep point, both leave the ball for the other and it races away. It was full and angling away, Rahul just timed that well with an open bat face
Short and around off, pulls it off the front foot to deep midwicket
Slower one just outside off, he goes for the punch but misses
Poor ball. Goes wide of the crease and bowls it full on the pads at 133.9kph,. Pooran flicks it well wide of short fine leg
Offcutter wider outside off, Pooran slashes and misses. Wide given
Superb shot. Full and on off, Pooran gets his stride out, opens the face and gets it all along the ground through backward point
Outside off, creamed through covers for two more
Full on leg, whipped to midwicket, where Deshpande dives and stops
Gone... out of the ground! Length ball on middle and leg, nicely in Pooran's slot. He clears his front leg and hoists it into the long-on stands
Full and outside off, hit to cover and runs with the shot. Wide throw but a direct hit would have made things interesting. Goner perhaps
Very full ball on middle to start, punched towards mid-off for a quick one
Length ball outside off, flayed to deep point

Finally the breakthrough! The most low-key of celebrations there could be for a wicket. Back of a length, offcutter again, de Kock goes back to ramp it over the wicketkeeper but only manages a feather. Unable to get away from the line, too. Dhoni does the rest and de Kock walks. End of a stupendous opening partnership that all but seals it for LSG at home
Oh my! Shot. Deft touch. Placement. Perfection. Offcutter on a length outside off, de Kock goes deep in the crease, plays it late and steers it past backward point
Hangs deep in the crease and cuts it to deep point

Once again moves across early but Rahul has struck it wonderfully well. The Fizz bowls it full and wider, but Rahul adjusts and slices it all along the ground through point to beat deep third to the right
Sees Rahul move across early and bowls a full toss wide outside off. Rahul manages to sweep it in front of square on the on side and gets two
Length ball on off, heaved away to deep midwicket to bring up his third fifty of IPL 2024
Sprays the slower one down leg, he goes for the swipe but misses
Yorker on middle, from around the wicket, dug out back towards the bowler.
Fuller outside off, driven to deep cover
Smartly done. De Kock knows the line Deshpande is bowling, quickly switches the bat position and reverses it over short third
Full and wide again, de Kock does not connect the drive
Full but very wide, and QdK leaves it be
SHort and around off, pulls it all along the ground to deep midwicket
Length ball outside off, punched to sweeper on the off side
Full and outside off, 136.9kph, pushes to short cover
Back of a length, angling away, pulled wide of long-on
Bangs it short around off, de Kock misses the pull. Wide called. QdK is not happy about something. Is it the spidercam? Seems so
Full and outside off, de Kock swings to the on side but misses. Pass close to the inside edge and off stump
Almost sneaks through. Full on off, Rahul goes for the drive but gets an inside edge to the on side
On a length on off and middle, wristed to short midwicket
Length bal wide outside off, mistimes the slap to cover
Length ball on middle, knocks it towards cover
Beats fine leg this time. Short and down leg again, he is into position early and pulls it through backward square leg. Pathirana rushes to his left but stands no chance
De Kock taps the length ball to the on side and sprints to the other end
Bangs it short outside leg again, pulled to fine leg
Short and just outside leg, 133.4kph, Rahul looks to pull but only gets it off the glove towards the bowler
Slower one on a fullish length on middle, punched towards cover
Slaps the length ball to sweeper cover to keep strike

Unintentional but in the gap. Lands it on a length outside off, 98.5kph, Rahul goes back and slices it between backward point and short third. Jadeja feels it was there to be caught but it was away from both of Deshpande and Mustafizur
Fifty for KLR, his 35th in the IPL. Goes back and cuts it through point o get to the mark
Eases the next one through midwicket to get to the other end
This time connects. Quicker and fuller outside leg, de Kock goes back and swivels to pick it up over backward square
Slower through the air, flighted outside leg, de Kock looks to slog but misses
Floated full on off, driven back. Rahul's wait on 49 continues
Goes back and punches this to long-off
Spins away from the outside edge as de Kock presses forward to drive
Goes back to the inspinning one and clips it to deep midwicket
Slower through the air, lands it outside off, Rahul goes back and punches it through cover and gets two
Lands it on a fullish length around middle and leg, he comes forward and works it through midwicket
Flatter and quicker on a length on middle, 102.8kph, goes back and heaved to long-on
Huge appeal but Jadeja is the only one. Dhoni suggests bat. Rahul went for the sweep but it goes off his pad to the off side. Inside edge?
Fuller on the pad, turned through square leg
Goes back and punches it through cover

What have you done, Pathirana? De Kock looks to slog Jadeja over the on side but skies it high. Short third runs back and to his right, never looked to be under it and shells it. How costly will this prove? Jadeja has his hands on his face
Lofted straight drive, picture perfect. De Kock backs away early, Jadeja lands it on a length on leg, gets under it and beats long-off
Full on leg, flicked wide of mid-on for one
Another bumper on middle and leg, Rahul keeps the pull down to deep square leg
Full on middle, looks to heave it away but gets it off the inner half to deep backward square leg
Length ball on the pads, tucked away to fine leg
Uses Pathirana's pace! Trying to repeat the SKY dismissal from the last outing and bowls a bouncer just outside off at 135.4kph. Rahul, though, stands tall and ramps it well over deep third
Full length ball outside off, Rahul tries to reach out but cannot. Wide called. Close but CSK don't review
Full and on the pads, flicked to deep square leg
Slows it down, on the pads, 85.2kph, turns it through midwicket and gets to the other end
Slower through the air on middle and leg, de Kock backs away and slogs it towards deep midwicket. Rizvi had to rush to his left, dive and keep the ball in play, allowing the batters two
Fuller on middle and leg, eases it through midwicket and collects two
Flatter and quicker on middle, on a length, he goes back and punches it through point
Floated full outside off, knocked down to long-on
Fuller on middle, 90.1kph, Rahul eases it to sweeper cover
Starts off with a slider down leg, he misses the flick
Mistimes an aerial pull towards deep midwicket. Another short ball, 133kph, Rahul does not get the timing right
Another slower one, short of a length around off. Catches Rahul by surprise. He hops and looks to flatbat it but the ball does not arrive
Length ball outside off, mistimes it in front of point
Another bumper just outside off, 134.6kph, Rahul looks to upper cut but misses. And voices his disappointment. Should have hit that

Fine shot and it goes the distance Chahar is bowling short with the field on the off side up. And he is also bowling slower ones, which allows Rahul all the time in the world. Once again hops and slaps it well over extra cover
Digs it short and wide outside off, it is the slower one as well. Rahul backs away, jumps and slaps it over short third

Connects and just clears deep square leg. Back of a length around off and middle, angling away, 123.7kph, de Kock goes back and whips it across the line. Ravindra at deep midwicket gets to his left but it was way over
Missed leg by a whisker! Once again de Kock backs away but Deshpande bowls a perfect yorker at 135.8kph. Just that it was not on the stumps
Slower one around middle and leg, de Kock backs away to loft it over the off side but gets it off the bottom edge to mid-on
Full toss, he misses the flick and is rapped on the pads, 141.3kph, takes a leg-bye as the ball roles to short fine leg's left
Back of a length, 141.kph, rushes quickly onto Rahul, who mistimes the pull towards midwicket
Whipped away. Back of a length, 127kph, angling in. Rahul gets inside the line and plays it wide of fine leg who is inside the circle
Fuller around off, looks to drive to off but Jadeja dives to his left and prevents a run
Slower one, full outside off, sliced to deep point, 113.4kph
Full and outside off, opens the face to get it to deep backward point, 141kph
Angling away on a length, steered towards point
Hammered back and Fizz almost had to take evasive action. Lands it on a length on middle, he drives it back on the up. Not enough time to react and it goes over the bowler's head
Appeal for lbw straightaway. Bat first? Probably. Spears it straight and full around off, de Kock hangs on the back foot and gets a thick inside edge onto his back leg
Another bouncer, much quicker, Rahul thinks of pulling but sways away, 130.9kph
Rahul goes up and over and gets maximum! Early intent from the LSG captain. Sees the back of a length ball outside off, clears his front leg and tonks it over deep midwicket
Digs it in and catches de Kock by surprise. He manages to get the pull through midwicket for one. 137.4kph
Around good length on off, he gets it off the outer half towards deep point
Length ball outside off, looks to chop it away but gets a bottom edge towards the keeper, who parries it to slip with a jump
Easy peasy! Length ball outside off, Rahul has ample time to go back and heave it across the line. It was a legcutter outside off at 128.8kph. He picks his spot through midwicket
Lands in a no man's land. De Kock looks to go hard over the off side, but Deshpande had taken pace off, 115.8kph. Gets a top edge that flies over backward point and he gets a couple
Fuller around off, 140.4kph, driven off the inner half towards mid-on and Rahul sprints to the other end
Fuller and outside off, mistimed towards mid-off and that allows him a run. 141.9kph
Slower one does QdK in, angling away on a length, he tries to reach out but then lets it be. Given wide
Full and outside off, squeezed out to backward point
Pick up and go! The trademark de Kock shot. Length ball on the thigh, he hangs back and lifts it over backward square leg
Full and outside off, driven crisply, straight to mid-off
Angling away on a length, he hangs back and slices it all along the ground past backward point
Full-blooded dive from Rasheed, the sub, at cover, keeps it down to one. Rahul stands tall and punches the length ball through off
Length ball, moving away outside off, walks forward and eases it towards backward point
Length ball on the pads, tucked away through square leg to get going
Fuller on middle and leg, moving away a touch, kept out towards midwicket
Generates a bit of inward movement with the length ball at 140.4kph, around off and middle, punched to the on side
